parole.significato: elsewhere (in or at some other place)
parole.testo: From alhur, from Old Galician-Portuguese allur, likely from Latin aliorsum, maybe via Old Occitan. Compare with French ailleurs, Occitan alhors, and Romanian aiurea. See also Portuguese algures.
From Old Galician-Portuguese romanço, from Latin rōmānice (Roman, adverb), via Old Occitan romans.
